Duas frentes de pesquisa sustentam o des: Two research tracks support ARARAT's development: aggressiveness classification using T2 radiomics, with a published study, and prostate and lesion segmentation, with a manuscript in its final revisions. These are separate studies with internal evaluation; external validation is ongoing.
Em Clinical Radiology (2026), radiômica: In Clinical Radiology (2026), T2 radiomics and machine learning were studied to distinguish ISUP < 3 from ISUP ≥ 3 in biopsy-confirmed cancer lesions. This is not a study of cancer detection in examinations without a diagnosis.
O manuscrito analisa a delimitação da pr: The manuscript analyzes prostate and lesion delineation using public, de-identified data and a held-out internal test set. Still unpublished, it investigates where models succeed and where they fail.
Na pesquisa de segmentação, alvos menore: In segmentation research, smaller targets and lower-suspicion lesions concentrate the difficulties. Classification results are limited to the population and protocol studied. Human review remains essential.
Os estudos não validam um fluxo automáti: The studies do not validate a complete automated workflow or the platform as a whole. Their results cannot be attributed to another model or software version without demonstrating equivalence.
Atenção ao comportamento do modelo fora: Attention to model behavior outside its development data — hence the need for external validation.
Registrar a série, a região de interesse: Recording the series, region of interest, preprocessing, features and model version is necessary to link an estimate to the protocol that produced it.
O estudo publicado utilizou SHAP para an: The published study used SHAP to analyze feature contributions. This supports interpretation; it neither proves a result is correct nor reveals all of the model's causal relationships. The XAI panel shown in the Viewer is not yet available.
A publicação apresenta resultados de ava: The publication presents internal evaluation results, not the platform's clinical effectiveness. This website does not present performance metrics or regulatory certification.
Imagens, máscaras, capturas e contribuiç: Images, masks, screenshots and contributions shown on this website are demonstrations.
O estudo analisou 112 lesões com câncer: The study analyzed 112 confirmed cancer lesions from PROSTATEx. It used axial T2 and a spherical 3D ROI with a 5 mm radius, centered on a previously identified lesion. Features extracted with PyRadiomics were used by a Random Forest classifier; SHAP was used to analyze their contributions. The demonstration's automatic mask does not reproduce this protocol.
Em outra base de dados, modelos separado: In another dataset, separate models analyze the whole prostate on T2 and lesions on T2, ADC and DWI. The lesion target is ISUP ≥ 2, different from the published classifier's ISUP ≥ 3 threshold. The manuscript does not validate classifiers, scores or explainability.
